source_snapshot.procedure: Move switch to alternate side; power on and inspect jumper-function page; restore.
source_snapshot.criteria: Powers on; switch functions; restored system neither hangs nor logs error.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH with exact switch, power/ESD, configuration backup and recovery.

old_problem: The board switch/positions and vendor electrical sequence are missing, and some Clear-CMOS controls must never be powered in the clear position. Expected service page, exact settings reset and boot/storage/security recovery are undefined.
disposition_reason: ED-09 keeps physical work manual, but cannot legalize an unsafe literal power-on. The board-specific control semantics and recovery are core hardware safety evidence, not ordinary runtime IDs. Until the vendor procedure proves powered alternate-position use and restoration, execution is blocked.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2261 and 2262, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records, unique identity and noncontiguous queue transition were reviewed.
Preserve alternate-position, power-on/service-page, original-position restoration and clean boot/log coverage.
Require board revision, designator and photographed original/alternate positions plus authoritative vendor power-off/discharge and power-on allowance.
Qualified operator uses ESD controls; automation may only capture BIOS/configuration/log evidence.
Back up BIOS/security/storage/boot settings and define intended defaults/deltas, service indication and exact restored final state.
No chassis access, switch movement, discharge, power-on, CMOS clear, configuration restore or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Vendor-governed physical Clear-CMOS switch function and restoration
test_case.purpose: Verify the exact board Clear-CMOS control produces its documented service indication/configuration effect and that normal switch position and platform configuration recover to a clean boot.
required_package: Board revision and Clear-CMOS designator/position map
Expected jumper/service page and CMOS setting/default delta
BIOS/storage/security backup, console access and restoration plan
test_case.test_command: Gate closed. A qualified operator follows the vendor power/ESD sequence, photographs initial/alternate/final positions, moves only the named control, powers the system in the alternate position only if explicitly permitted, captures the service page/effect, powers down, restores the original position and verifies configuration and clean boot/log health.
test_case.expected_result: The documented service indication and exact allowed CMOS configuration change occur in the alternate position; after restoring the original position, the approved boot/storage/security settings and system health are recovered with no disallowed events.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an authoritative board procedure, exact physical evidence, expected CMOS delta and verified restoration. Power-on alone cannot pass. Missing power safety/recovery keeps Pending and execution BLOCKED; wrong control, unexpected reset or failed recovery is FAIL.
safety_gate: No action until vendor explicitly defines whether alternate-position power-on is safe.
Fully de-energize/discharge and use ESD controls before switch movement.
Qualified operator only; verify designator and positions photographically.
Stop on wrong control, damage, boot/configuration loss or recovery ambiguity; no retry.
expected_evidence: Service page/message and CMOS configuration diff
test_case.recovery: If the platform fails to boot or settings drift, leave power safe, preserve physical/console evidence and restore only through the vendor-approved original position, saved configuration and recovery media; never toggle or power-cycle blindly.

source_conflict.reason: The source intent is coherent; the missing vendor safety and oracle are omissions.

blocked.reason: Execution is unsafe until the vendor proves the alternate-position power sequence and recoverable configuration effect.
